name: Urban Tree Species Time Series Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset for time series classification focused on identifying urban tree species from temporal sensor or remote-sensing signals.
reputation: Niche benchmark in the remote sensing and ecology communities for species ID from temporal signals, with modest adoption in specialist research.
notes: Likely class imbalance and limited samples per species; seasonal/temporal biases possible. Non-LLM benchmark focused on sensor/remote-sensing time series.
